[1] Lucy Pevensie: Lucy Pevensie is a fictional character in C. S. Lewis's "The Chronicles of Narnia" series. Of all the Pevensie children, Lucy is the closest to Aslan. Also, of all the humans who have visited Narnia, Lucy is perhaps the one that believes in Narnia the most. She is ultimately crowned Queen Lucy the Valiant, co-ruler of Narnia along with her two brothers and her sister. Lucy is the central character of the four siblings in the novels. Meyer was the bestselling author of 2008 and 2009 in America, having sold over 29 million books in 2008, and 26.5 million books in 2009. "Twilight" was the best-selling book of 2008 in US bookstores.
